tagline: An intellectual curiosity and knowledge magazine exploring humanity, history, science, technology, philosophy, psychology, nature, existence and imagination.

history_extraordinary_personalities.description: Fascinating conquerors, rulers, scientists, inventors, philosophers, and visionaries explored through psychology, pivotal decisions, forgotten inventions, and turning points.

science_ai_technology.description: Artificial intelligence, quantum physics, space exploration, 4th dimension, mathematics, neuroscience, and the future of humanity.

philosophy_psychology.description: Stoicism, existentialism, human behavior, cognitive biases, dark psychology, decision making, consciousness, and moral dilemmas.

entrepreneurship_billionaires.description: Business empires, asymmetric risk management, visionary strategies, negotiation, innovation, and post-mortems of business failures.

human_biology_nature.description: Human anatomy, brain architecture, DNA, evolution, sensory adaptations, mathematical patterns in nature, and biodiverse ecosystems.

horror_scifi_mysteries.description: Thought-provoking speculative science fiction, time loops, alternate realities, space mysteries, and psychological mysteries (clearly labeled as fiction).

quotes_puzzles_games.description: Verified historical/scientific quotations, deep philosophical reflections, paradoxes, chess puzzles, and logic riddles.
